note: Written after gates G1-G3 PASS and before any training run (smoke included). Eval answers not seen.
excluded_rule: rewrite once; fail at round-2 audit or G2 -> excluded (data/excluded.json, 20 facts rows)

primary_metrics.facts: acc over strata b+c+d (80 questions, cluster bootstrap by fact_id); knowledge claims only from b-d; strata a reported separately as memorization ceiling; control: hallucination rate
primary_metrics.ood: strict accuracy per category and overall; format_contamination and regulation_contaminated rates

secondary_metrics: verdict_acc, principle_acc, format_ok, per-strata facts acc, style_score per rule, OOD lenient; Holm correction for secondary comparisons

comparisons.delta_tune: best+weak - base+weak (format: best+weak is off-distribution, tuned with FORMAT_GOOD; reported for reference)
comparisons.overfit: overfit vs best on same cells, dissimilar, OOD

non_inferiority: OOD: lower bound of 95% paired bootstrap CI of (tuned - base) >= -5 pp; else degradation recorded

manual_scoring.ood_nonexistent: 10 rows OK_MANUAL: regex refusal detector unreliable (audit round 2); every answer of base/best/overfit labelled blind (refusal vs hallucination) by an independent annotator; automatic value shown for reference
manual_scoring.facts_control: automatic is_refusal + blind manual check of all control answers; manual label is primary
manual_scoring.dissimilar: rows with checker none labelled blind by note

checkpoint_selection.best: among 3 checkpoints with lowest macro valid loss, max mean of (format both_acc, facts_acc, style_all) on valid by generation; tie -> lower loss. Eval never used.
checkpoint_selection.overfit_point_S: first step after which valid loss >= min + 0.05 for two consecutive evals while train EMA keeps falling (per task and macro)
checkpoint_selection.overfit: last checkpoint; if macro valid@last < min + 0.1 the report states that macro overfitting was not reached and reports per-task

training.smoke: 40 steps, MLP keys + clip 1.0 + scale 8; stable if no NaN/inf, no >30% jump between reports, loss@40 < loss@5; else attention-only (Day7 4b recipe)
training.main: iters 550, warmup 30, then constant lr 2e-5, batch 4, save/eval every 25, seed 42; if smoke forecast > 3.2 h, iters = forecast-fit but >= 450 (recorded here before start)

known_limitations: G3 no_intro proxy fixed once and re-checked on the same 30 labels
facts train questions are slot templates (low lexical diversity)
strata b shrank 60 -> 47 after exclusions: single-degree facts inevitably overlap T1/T3 frames

amendments.before: main training run (eval answers still unseen)
amendments.what: main run uses stock mlx_lm.lora with the Day7 4b recipe: attention-only q/k/v/o, r8, scale 20, dropout 0.05, NO grad clipping, lr 2e-5 warmup 40 then cosine_decay to 2e-6 over 510 steps, 550 iters, save every 25 (configs/main_stock.yaml). Per-task valid loss computed offline for every checkpoint (val_ckpts.py) in the same log format.
amendments.why: smoke_mlp (MLP+clip 1.0) and smoke_attn (attn+clip 1.0) diverged (val macro 2.45 -> 3.84 / 3.74 in 40 steps); our train.py without clipping also degraded (pooled 2.225 -> 2.565 at step 30); stock trainer with the 4b recipe on the same mix was stable (pooled 2.225 -> 1.834 at step 40). Raw grad norm of this 4-bit model is ~1e8 in every run, so clip 1.0 renormalises every step.
amendments.effect_on_plan: MLP rejected per smoke rule. Constant lr replaced by cosine: overfitting point S is still defined on the per-task valid curves (rule unchanged); late-stage lr is lower, so overfitting may be weaker — reported as is.

amendments.before: fs training run; eval answers still unseen (only valid generations of the main run were looked at)
amendments.what: extra adapter fs trained on facts+style only (data/fs: 251 train = 150 facts + 101 style, valid 50), stock mlx_lm.lora, attention-only r8 scale 20 dropout 0.05, lr 5e-5 constant after warmup 20, 1250 iters (~20 epochs), save every 25 (configs/fs.yaml). Facts and style cells are evaluated on fs best/overfit (in addition to main); format cells on main; OOD and dissimilar on both.
amendments.why: main adapter (550 steps, cosine 2e-5) did not memorise facts or style even on train questions (valid gen: facts 1/30, style_all 0/20; train questions answered like the base) and showed no overfitting: knowledge conclusions on it would confuse 'did not learn' with 'does not generalise'. fs smoke: lr 1e-4 unstable (val 2.80 -> 1.87 -> 2.41), lr 5e-5 stable (2.80 -> 2.06 in 60 steps). User approved the extra run beyond the 3 h training budget.
amendments.selection: same rules as main: best among the 3 lowest macro(facts, style) valid-loss checkpoints by valid generation score mean(facts_acc, style_all); S per the prereg rule; overfit = last checkpoint. 3 of 251 train rows (longest) are dropped by the stock batcher every epoch (251 % 4).
